title: sharkd: Add session request type
description:
This change adds a request type called session that enables us to extend
the sharkd api protocol whilst maintaining backward compatibility for
solutions built on the original protocol.

Closes #17224

Both this and the next check have an off-by-one, they lack space for the trailing 0 byte (yay, C...).

```suggestion:-0+0
	if (strlen(tok_userid) >= sizeof(session_userid))
```
Thanks for the patch, let's discuss this feature first in #17224. Until then this should not be merged.
Hi @Lekensteyn, As we discussed, I won’t pursue this.  I’ll create another Merge Request related to alignment of the API with JSON-RPC.
